brief:
Israelis remain split over Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's political future as the country prepares for general elections, Al Jazeera English reported. Some voters call for change in leadership while others back Netanyahu to remain in power, reflecting deeper divisions within the electorate over the direction of the government.

The election comes amid ongoing debate over Netanyahu's tenure and governance. Views among the Israeli public diverge significantly on whether a change in administration is necessary or whether Netanyahu should continue leading the country.
dek: On the eve of Israel’s general election, some Israelis call for change while others back Netanyahu to stay in power.
title: Israelis divided on Netanyahu's future ahead of election vote
